results.title: INTs caused by Receiver?
results.description: So I just saw this. Have never heard anyone mention before in my life (face to face or in the media) but thought it was an interesting thing to post. When I think back and look at all of Allen's INTs, most are justified. But I do remember quite a few that were balls that went through the receivers hands, skipped off of them, etc. I'm sure it would only end up changing his INT numbers by 5-8 INTs but still an interesting topic none the less.

results.title: Hawks, Hornets Have Talked Buddy Hield, Dorian Finney-Smith Trade
results.description: The Atlanta Hawks and Charlotte Hornets both have moves to make to get into regular season roster compliance next month. That hasn't stopped the two teams from discussing a trade of veteran players who are on the roster bubble. Atlanta and Charlotte have discussed swapping Buddy Hield for Dorian Finney-Smith. The Hawks could be acquiring Finney-Smith with the idea of adding another defensive-minded player to the roster. Finney-Smith's contract for the 2027-28 season is non-guaranteed. That means it would have no impact on Atlanta's plans for cap space next summer. Hield's contract is partially guaranteed for just over $3 million for the 2027-28 season. It's unlikely that Hield would make the Hornets regular season roster, as Charlotte is currently carrying 16 fully guaranteed contracts.
